messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty — latency p99 alert firing for prod.us-west inference-cluster. threshold=1200ms; current p99=1840ms. Link: https://metrics.example.com/alert/98765
maya: ack. looking now.
raj: ack. i'm available, will take lead on mitigation.
tom: seeing elevated 502 errors reported by customers on streaming endpoints. also higher tail on chat endpoints.
maya: quick telemetry: autoscale pool gpu-util=93%, queue_depth=420, kv-cache_evictions spike x3 in last 10m.
raj: running quick metric query: `GET https://internal-metrics/api/v1/query?expr=p99_latency{cluster="prod-us-west"}` -> p99=1842ms
maya: probable hotkey + cache thrash. suggest immediate traffic diversion to lower-latency model variant for non-critical routes.
raj: prepare to flip routing for route=/v1/chat/stream. will do canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% if stable.
raj: applying canary now:
```
curl -XPOST https://ops-api.local/reroute \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/chat/stream","target":"redwood-model/m-l2-quant","canary_pct":10}'
```
maya: spinning 4 extra small workers in dedicated pool to absorb burst (scale-up requested).
maya: `kubectl -n inference scale deployment/worker-small --replicas=4` — triggered.
tom: support: customers seeing p95 jump from ~700ms -> ~1600ms on streaming, but only ~2% error rate so far. drafting a short incident note for affected clients.
raj: canary telemetry after 2m: canary p99=920ms, error rate steady. moving to 50%.
maya: 50% steady for 3m, p99 overall dropped to ~980ms. kv-cache eviction rate falling.
sarah: i'm taking oncall handoff in 12m. prepping notes: issue: kv-thrash + queue backlog causing tail latency. mitigation: routing to quantized variant + scale-up + warm cache.
raj: promoting to 100% traffic now.
raj: post-change metrics: p99=860ms, p95=450ms, errors back to baseline. good signal.
incident-bot: Alert: latency p99 has returned below threshold. closing PagerDuty incident (ID: PD-98765).
maya: leaving a follow-up runbook task: root cause investigation on kv eviction policy + batching behavior during hotkeys. I'll open a tracking ticket.
sarah: copying summary to #incidents and #customer-ops for visibility. i'll include timeline and mitigation steps.
tom: thanks everyone. i'll update support thread with client note and attach current metrics.
maya: :thumbsup: great coordination. closing thread.
